t: Blipcare Launches Blip BP 800, Cellular Blood Pressure Monitor Specifically Designed for Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)
s: November 18, 2020 - 18, 2020 /PRNewswire/ -- Blipcare, the company that developed the world's first Wi-Fi blood pressure monitor, today announced availability of its new cellular blood pressure monitor, the Blip BP 800. The Blip BP800 is specifically designed to serve patients who need Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM).
